item.description:
The National League of American Pen Women (NLAPW) and the Golden Gate-Marin Branch are launching a poetry competition for women over 18 years of age who are not currently members of the NLAPW. This regional and national competition will be run at the Branch level in the semi-finalist phase. Local winners are automatically entered into the League’s National competition.

item.title: Thanksgiving Brunch at Bluewater Lounge, Bodega Bay — Thu Nov 26, 11:00 AM — 21301 Heron Dr
item.description:

item.description:

The experience includes the 2025 Terra Collection Rosé of Barbera from the North Coast paired with cranberry jam and Brie puff pastry bites; the 2022 Altura Collection Nebbiolo from Los Olivos served with cornbread and Spanish chorizo topped with pear chutney; and the 2021 Altura Collection Red Blend from Sonoma Valley paired with bacon-wrapped, blue cheese-stuffed dates with red wine and onion jam.
Source: Sonoma.com

item.title: Photos with Santa — Sat Nov 28, 9:00 AM — Brickmania
item.description:
Have you been naughty or nice? Santa doesn't care. He's got a soft spot for four-legged troublemakers!
Grab your furry best friend \(or your favorite human!\) and join the Humane Society of the North Bay for Photos with Santa at Brickmania!
Whether your pup is a perfect angel, your cat is plotting world domination, or your kids have a mile-long wish list, Santa is ready for his close-up! And he's offering not just one fun-filled day, but two dates! Twice as nice!

item.title: Saturday Harvest Market at Sonoma Garden Park — Sat Nov 28, 9:00 AM — Sonoma Garden Park
item.description:
Sonoma Garden Park’s 2023 full Harvest Markets are on Saturdays, 9:00 am-12:00 pm, starting from April 22, 2023. The Harvest Market is a great place to pick up produce, flowers, and eggs harvested from our 6.1 acre sustainable garden. We will be selling products such as fresh produce, eggs from free-range chickens, honey, and olive oil. The market now accepts credit cards. Remember to bring your reusable shopping bag!
To stay updated on our events, sign up for our newsletter at: sonomaecologycenter.org/newsletters-sign-up
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.description:
Join us live at the Mira Theatre every 3rd Saturday of the month. Vallejo Jazz Jam's mission is to provide a supportive and non-competitive environment for musicians of all levels to explore our rich heritage of jazz standards. The Vallejo Jazz Jam welcomes musicians of all ages, genders and levels. Monthly they develop a consensus of tunes to play for two-hour sessions, held on the third Saturday of the month. There is no formal hierarchy. Questions?: Patricia Kutza at pkutza@pacbell.net $10 donation to cover rental space \(pay in-person\) Event Website

item.title: Kamayan and Kwentuhan, A Dinner Gathering — Sun Nov 29, 5:30 PM — Wayside United Methodist Church
item.description:
Kapwa Collective invites the community to a shared meal! All are welcome! Our time will be guided by two Filipino mental health practitioners. At the end of the gathering, we will share various community resources.
This event is free, where food is provided by Kapwa Collective and Fellowship United Methodist Church! Kapwa Collective is an emerging faith space within the United Methodist Church that is bringing together Filipinos across generations to explore the intersection of justice, creativity, and faith.
Kamayan is the Filipino tradition of eating with your hands, sharing a feast spread across banana leaves. Kwentuhan is the act of sharing stories, while also finding ourselves in the stories of others. At this gathering we will engage in the following:

Enjoy food and drink specials are available for purchase during the quiz! Free to Play!!
